text:
```yaml
name: renovate
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  github-actions-update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 10
      - uses: browniebroke/github-actions-updater@v1.0.0
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.BOT_MASTER_RW_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit_message: "Automated GitHub Actions workflow updates"
          pr_title: "Automated GitHub Actions workflow updates"
          pr_body: "This PR updates the GitHub Actions workflows to their latest versions."
          labels: |
            dependencies
            automated
  general-js-deps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 10
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4.0.0
        with:
          version: 10.8.1
          run_install: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4.0.4
        with:
          node-version: 24.1.0
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install
      - name: Run JS dependency updater
        run: |
          pnpm run update:deps
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.BOT_MASTER_RW_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
